changeSet.author: nexus-6pfgb.42
changeSet.comment: Retire nexus.frecency (nexus-6pfgb.42): fail with the remedy named if a view the migrating role does not own still reads it (taxonomy-011-8, runAlways, has already re-pointed nexus.diag_chash_conformance at four legs), then DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.frecency. The table had no live writer or reader; the score the search path uses is the frecency_score key on chunk metadata, which this change leaves alone. DATA EFFECT: DROPs nexus.frecency, discarding every row it holds (a projection nothing reads); irreversible for the rows, and the rollback recreates the table's empty schema shape (the shape telemetry-001-11/-12, telemetry-006-1, legacy-001-3 and fk-006-1 left), not the data.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE v_views text; BEGIN SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname), ', ' ORDER BY format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname)) INTO v_views FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_rewrite r ON r.oid = d.objid AND d.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = r.ev_class JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE d.refobjid = to_regclass('nexus.frecency') AND c.oid <> d.refobjid; IF v_views IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'nexus-6pfgb.42: nexus.frecency cannot be dropped while % reads it. Remedy: if the migrating role owns the view, restart the engine once (taxonomy-011-8 re-points nexus.diag_chash_conformance at four legs on every boot, before this changeset; a view of any other name is for its owner to re-create). Otherwise the view''s owning role must re-create it without nexus.frecency (for nexus.diag_chash_conformance, the four-leg body of nexus.db.chash_tables.diag_conformance_view_ddl()) or drop it, then retry this migration.', v_views; END IF; END $$;
